      //Note: In the future, this can be used to apply "default" or "global" event properties to all amplitude events in a page.
      const enrichAmplitudeEventPropertiesPlugin = () => {
        return {
          execute: async (event) => {
            event.event_properties = {
              ...event.event_properties,
              ...{},
              pageType: 'Blog'
            }
            return event
          }
        }

      function getReferrer() {
        return document.referrer
      }

      function getReferrerHost() {
        let referrerHost = ''
        const referrer = getReferrer()

        if (referrer) {
          // Workaround to persist nuxt oversight
          referrerHost = new URL(referrer)[
            referrer.includes('411') ? 'origin' : 'host'
          ]
        }

        return referrerHost
      }

      async function cookieFetch(
        cookieName,
        newValue,
        shouldAssignNewValueIfCookieNonexistent
      ) {
        return waitForGetCookie(() => {
          const cookieValue = window.getCookie(cookieName)

          if (cookieValue) {
            return cookieValue
          }

          const newCookieValue = shouldAssignNewValueIfCookieNonexistent
            ? newValue
            : ''
          document.cookie = cookieName + '=' + newCookieValue + ';path=/'

          return newCookieValue
        })
      }

      function waitForGetCookie(callback, maxWaitMs = 2000) {
        const start = Date.now()

        function check() {
          if (typeof window.getCookie === 'function') {
            callback()
          } else if (Date.now() - start < maxWaitMs) {
            setTimeout(check, 10)
          } else {
            // Fallback: still call the callback, but warn
            console.warn(
              'window.getCookie not available after waiting, proceeding without it.'
            )
            callback()
          }
        }

        check()
      }

      async function fetchInitialReferrer() {
        const referrer = getReferrer()

        const shouldPersistValue =

        return cookieFetch('initial_referrer', referrer, shouldPersistValue)

            bowserScript?.addEventListener('load', () => {
              resInner('loaded')
            })
            setTimeout(() => {
              resInner('timeout')
            }, 2000)
          })
          bowserProm.then((status) => {
            if (status !== 'loaded') {
              resolve({
                browser: 'Unknown',
                version: 'Unknown'
              })
            } else {
              const info = window.bowser?.parse(window.navigator.userAgent)
              resolve({
                browser: info?.browser?.name || 'Unknown',
                version: info?.browser?.version || 'Unknown'
              })
            }
          })
        })

      function getParameters() {

Whitepages Pro API All Products Get the Whitepages App Log In Sign Up People Search Reverse Phone Reverse Address Search Search Case Study How GS home services doubled its close rate on outreach With the Whitepages Pro API, GS Home Services turns name-and-city searches into accurate, current mailing addresses and emails, making direct mail and email its most effective and efficient channels. 2x outreach close rate 90% accuracy of addresses and emails GS Home Services is a locally owned residential cleaning company in Indiana, known for meticulous work, eco-friendly products, and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. With strong reviews and high client retention, the family-run business was ready to invest more in growth. The Challenge GS had a solid customer list, but it was missing reliable mailing and email addresses, and many contact records were stale. People move and change details constantly, so reaching them meant the team spent ten hours every week searching for accurate, up-to-date contact information by hand. The Company GS Home Services Industry Residential Cleaning Location New Albany, IN Website gshomeservice.com Start Free Trial View Pricing The Solution GS Home Services built an automated process around the Whitepages Pro API. The workflow starts with the names and cities on its customer list, then appends the list with updated mailing addresses and emails. Because the API supplies contact information automatically, a task that used to take ten hours a week now takes thirty minutes. The accuracy of that contact data comes from how Whitepages matches people to contact information. The Whitepages Identity Graph links a name to the address and email that person uses today and keeps pace as those records change, so GS reaches the right people instead of sending outreach to outdated addresses. The Results With the Whitepages Pro API, GS Home Services turned direct mail and email into a stronger growth channel. Its close rate on outreach doubled thanks to mailing addresses and emails the team estimates are 90% accurate. For a small, family-run business, that kind of efficiency is what makes growth affordable. 2x outreach close rate 90% accuracy of addresses and emails The addresses and emails are extremely accurate, and we’re reaching the right people much more of the time.     <script>
      //Note: In the future, this can be used to apply "default" or "global" event properties to all amplitude events in a page.
      const enrichAmplitudeEventPropertiesPlugin = () => {
        return {
          execute: async (event) => {
            event.event_properties = {
              ...event.event_properties,
              ...{},
              pageType: 'About'
            }
            return event
          }
        }
      }

      function getReferrer() {
        return document.referrer
      }

      function getReferrerHost() {
        let referrerHost = ''
        const referrer = getReferrer()

        if (referrer) {
          // Workaround to persist nuxt oversight
          referrerHost = new URL(referrer)[
            referrer.includes('411') ? 'origin' : 'host'
          ]
        }

        return referrerHost
      }

      async function cookieFetch(
        cookieName,
        newValue,
        shouldAssignNewValueIfCookieNonexistent
      ) {
        return waitForGetCookie(() => {
          const cookieValue = window.getCookie(cookieName)

          if (cookieValue) {
            return cookieValue
          }

          const newCookieValue = shouldAssignNewValueIfCookieNonexistent
            ? newValue
            : ''
          document.cookie = cookieName + '=' + newCookieValue + ';path=/'

          return newCookieValue
        })
      }

      function waitForGetCookie(callback, maxWaitMs = 2000) {
        const start = Date.now()

        function check() {
          if (typeof window.getCookie === 'function') {
            callback()
          } else if (Date.now() - start < maxWaitMs) {
            setTimeout(check, 10)
          } else {
            // Fallback: still call the callback, but warn
            console.warn(
              'window.getCookie not available after waiting, proceeding without it.'
            )
            callback()
          }
        }

        check()
      }

      async function fetchInitialReferrer() {
        const referrer = getReferrer()

        const shouldPersistValue =
          referrer?.includes(window.location.hostname) === false

        return cookieFetch('initial_referrer', referrer, shouldPersistValue)
      }

      function getBrowserAndVersion() {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const bowserScript = document.querySelector('#bowser-script')
          const bowserProm = new Promise((resInner) => {
            window.bowser !== undefined ? resInner('loaded') : null
            bowserScript?.addEventListener('load', () => {
              resInner('loaded')
            })
            setTimeout(() => {
              resInner('timeout')
            }, 2000)
          })
          bowserProm.then((status) => {
            if (status !== 'loaded') {
              resolve({
                browser: 'Unknown',
                version: 'Unknown'
              })
            } else {
              const info = window.bowser?.parse(window.navigator.userAgent)
              resolve({
                browser: info?.browser?.name || 'Unknown',
                version: info?.browser?.version || 'Unknown'
              })
            }
          })
        })
      }

      function getBrowserDimensions() {
        return {
          width: window.innerWidth,
          height: window.innerHeight
        }
      }

      function getParameters() {
        const params = new URL(window.location).searchParams

        const validSemAndUtmKeys = [
          'address_url',
          'd',
          'gb',
          'gclid',
          'sem_account_id',
          'sem_ad_group_id',
          'sem_ad_id',
          'sem_ad_tag',
          'sem_area_code',
          'sem_campaign_id',
          'sem_device_type',
          'sem_fn',
          'sem_form',
          'sem_headline',
          'sem_keyword',
          'sem_line',
          'sem_ln',
          'sem_lob',
          'sem_loc',
          'sem_location_id',
          'sem_matchtype',
          'sem_network',
          'sem_path',
          'sem_placement',
          'sem_placement_category',
          'sem_prefix',
          'sem_target_id',
          'utm_campaign',
          'utm_medium',
          'utm_source',
          'utm_term',
          'utm_content'
        ]

        const semAndUtmProperties = { is_sem: !!params.get('is_sem') }

        validSemAndUtmKeys.forEach((key) => {
          if (params.get(key)) {
            semAndUtmProperties[key] = params.get(key)
          }
        })

        return semAndUtmProperties
      }

      getBrowserAndVersion().then((browserResult) => {
        const ampScript = document.querySelector('#amplitude-script')
        const ampProm = new Promise((resolve) => {
          window.amplitude !== undefined ? resolve('loaded') : null
          ampScript?.addEventListener('load', () => {
            resolve('loaded')
          })
        })

        const AMPLITUDE_KEY =
          '4452f969da1962f05527ab14f5db83da'
        const amplitudeOptions = {
          includeReferrer: false,
          batchEvents: true,
          eventUploadPeriodMillis: 10,
          defaultTracking: false
        }
        ampProm.then(async () => {
          const amplitude = window.amplitude
          amplitude.add(enrichAmplitudeEventPropertiesPlugin())
          amplitude.init(AMPLITUDE_KEY, null, amplitudeOptions)

          const referrer = getReferrer()
          const referrerDomain = getReferrerHost()
          const initialReferrer = await fetchInitialReferrer()
          const browser = browserResult.browser
          const version = browserResult.version
          const { width, height } = getBrowserDimensions()
          const semUtmProperties = getParameters()

          const userProperties = [
            {
              key: 'userId',
              value: ''
            },
            {
              key: 'userDisabled',
              value: 'true'
            },
            {
              key: 'userName',
              value: ''
            },
            {
              key: 'userEmail',
              value: ''
            },
            {
              key: 'userType',
              value: 'free'
            },
            {
              key: 'wpUser',
              value: 'free'
            },
            {
              key: 'userProductId',
              value: ''
            },
            {
              key: 'userProductName',
              value: ''
            },
            {
              key: 'userProductAnalyticsName',
              value: ''
            },
            {
              key: 'userProductHasPropertyFeatures',
              value: 'false'
            },
            {
              key: 'userBillingCycle',
              value: ''
            }
          ]

          try {
            const additionalUserTestValues = JSON.parse('[{"key":"UserTestID7","value":"ocu_modal_on_address_details_0"}]')
            additionalUserTestValues.forEach((value) => {
              userProperties.push(value)
            })
          } catch {
            console.error(
              'non-fatal - unable to add additional user properties - json parse failed'
            )
          }

          const identifyEvent = new amplitude.Identify()
          identifyEvent.set('utm_source', initialReferrer)
          Object.keys(semUtmProperties).forEach((key) => {
            identifyEvent.set(key, semUtmProperties[key])
          })
          userProperties.forEach((pair) => {

          const hasSemSignal =

            Object.keys(semUtmProperties).some(

            )
          if (hasSemSignal) {
            identifyEvent.set(

          amplitude.identify(identifyEvent)

          let additionalDefaultProperties = {}

          } catch {
            console.error(

          amplitude.defaultProperties = {

            userProductId: '',

            userHasPropertyFeatures: 'false',

              '',
            userProductAnalyticsName:
              '',
            userBillingCycle: '',
            routeName:
              window.route_name ||
              `no routename found on URL: ${window.location.pathname}`,
            ...(additionalDefaultProperties || {})
          }

          const pageEventProperties = {
            ...amplitude.defaultProperties
          }

          // Set Amplitude User ID - All users are free users on 411, as of Nov 2023
          window.amplitude.setUserId(null)

          function cleanAmpEventName(name) {
            return encodeURIComponent(name)
              .replace(/%20/g, '_') // Replace spaces with underscores
              .replace(/%2F/g, '_') // Replace slashes with underscores
              .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, '') // Remove any other special characters
          }

          function postUserActivityEvent(eventName) {
            let identifier = amplitude.getUserId() || amplitude.getDeviceId()
            if (!identifier) {
              setTimeout(function () {
                let id = amplitude.getUserId() || amplitude.getDeviceId()
                if (!id) return
                postUserActivityIngest(id, eventName)
              }, 1000)
              return
            }
            postUserActivityIngest(identifier, eventName)
          }

          function postUserActivityIngest(identifier, eventName) {
            fetch('/api/user-activity/ingest', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                events: [
                  {
                    identifier: identifier,
                    event_name: eventName
                  }
                ]
              })
            }).catch(function () {})
          }

          function sendAmpEventForElement(element, event) {
            let eventName = cleanAmpEventName(
              element.dataset?.ampLabel || 'InvalidEventName'
            )
            let xtraEventPropsRaw = element.dataset?.ampProps || '{}'
            let xtraEventProps = JSON.parse(
              decodeURIComponent(xtraEventPropsRaw)
            )
            const eventProps = {
              ...amplitude.defaultProperties,
              ...xtraEventProps
            }
            amplitude.track(eventName, eventProps)

            postUserActivityEvent(eventName)

            if (event) {
              event()
            }
          }

          // Send pageview event
          const pageViewEventElement = document.querySelector(
            'body.amp-view-event'
          )

          if (pageViewEventElement !== null) {
            sendAmpEventForElement(pageViewEventElement)
          }

          function bindAmplitudeEvents(
            DOMQuery,
            eventType,
            amplitudeEventFunction
          ) {
            const allElements = document.querySelectorAll(DOMQuery)
            allElements.forEach((element) => {
              if (
                element.href &&
                (element.href.includes('www.whitepages.com') ||
                  element.href.includes('staging.whitepages.com'))
              ) {
                const sessionId = window.amplitude.getSessionId()
                const deviceId = window.amplitude.getDeviceId()

                // Check if sessionId and deviceId are valid
                const params = []
                if (sessionId) params.push('amplitudeSessionId=' + sessionId)
                if (deviceId) params.push('deviceId=' + deviceId)

                if (params.length > 0) {
                  const [baseUrl, queryString] = element.href.split('?')
                  const updatedQueryString = queryString
                    ? queryString + '&' + params.join('&')
                    : params.join('&')

                  element.href = baseUrl + '?' + updatedQueryString
                }
              }
              //TODO: We should add an event listener higher up in the DOM that filters for specific events, instead of setting events for each element.
              element.addEventListener(eventType, (event) => {
                amplitudeEventFunction(element)
              })
            })
          }

          function attachAmplitude() {
            // unfortunately there is no callback to know when the identify event has been sent and the session id is available. So we have to poll for it.
            let attempts = 0
            const maxAttempts = 50 // 5 seconds / 100ms = 50 attempts

            function attachEventListener(element, eventType) {
              // Check if we've already attached a listener
              if (element.dataset.ampListenerAttached === 'true') return

              element.addEventListener(eventType, () => {
                sendAmpEventForElement(element)
                // Flush immediately so the event is sent before any navigation
                // begins — prevents bfcache from holding queued events that
                // would replay when the user presses Back.
                amplitude.flush()
              })

              // Mark that we've attached a listener
              element.dataset.ampListenerAttached = 'true'
            }

            function bindDynamicAmplitudeEvents(container) {
              // Find and bind click events
              const clickElements =
                container.getElementsByClassName('amp-click-event')
              Array.from(clickElements).forEach((element) => {
                if (element instanceof HTMLElement) {
                  attachEventListener(element, 'click')
                }
              })

              // Find and bind change events
              const changeElements =
                container.getElementsByClassName('amp-change-event')
              Array.from(changeElements).forEach((element) => {
                if (element instanceof HTMLElement) {
                  attachEventListener(element, 'change')
                }
              })

              // Find and bind submit events
              const submitElements =
                container.getElementsByClassName('amp-submit-event')
              Array.from(submitElements).forEach((element) => {
                if (element instanceof HTMLElement) {
                  attachEventListener(element, 'submit')
                }
              })
            }

            const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
              const sessionId = window.amplitude.getSessionId()
              if (sessionId || attempts >= maxAttempts) {
                clearInterval(intervalId)

                // Bind initial elements
                bindDynamicAmplitudeEvents(document.body)

                // Set up MutationObserver for htmx-inserted content
                const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
                  mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
                    mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {
                      if (node instanceof HTMLElement) {
                        bindDynamicAmplitudeEvents(node)
                      }
                    })
                  })
                })

                // Start observing the document with the configured parameters
                observer.observe(document.body, {
                  childList: true, // Watch for changes in direct children
                  subtree: true // Watch for changes in descendants
                })

                // Also bind any elements that might have been added before observer was set up
                bindDynamicAmplitudeEvents(document.body)
              }
              attempts++
            }, 100)
          }

          attachAmplitude()

          // Flush before page is hidden (covers both normal navigation and
          // bfcache entries — unload does not fire for bfcache, so queued
          // events would replay on back-navigation if we used unload here).
          document.querySelector('body').addEventListener('pagehide', () => {
            amplitude.flush()
          })
        })
      })
